Where are all the videos and the logs kept in Epstein’s residences?

Video

Congratulations to Chief Stephanie Price of the City of Beaufort Police Department for being selected for the 2026 Ted Poe Award for Excellence by a Public Official! 

Our office nominated Chief Price through the Survivors and Justice Caucus, and being chosen from a competitive pool proves what we already know: the Lowcountry is home to the best of the best. 

Chief Price sets the standard for excellence and our community is better for it. 

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: We helped secure authorization for $7.5 MILLION for wastewater and stormwater projects in Beaufort County.

Growth without infrastructure investment is a problem waiting to happen. This funding gets ahead of it. Clean water and better stormwater management keep our community prepared.

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: Our Protect American Fisheries Act will protect fishermen all around the country from anticompetitive foreign practices.

"NOAA's fishery disaster program must finally come to terms with the reality that imports completely dominate the U.S. market including for cod, haddock and other New England groundfish,” said Jackie Odell, Executive director of the Northeast Seafood Coalition. "Like so many U.S. fisheries, we need Rep. Mace's bill."

American fishermen feed our American families an

Check out this letter from Frank Gary, a Citadel graduate, about our office stepping in to help get his Social Security disability case moving after years of delays.

When our constituents need help, we do not waste time, we step in and get to work.

If you are a constituent who needs help navigating federal agencies or casework issues, please visit mace.house.gov/constituentse…

I don't care what party you're in. If you sexually assault or sexually harass your employee (or anyone), you have no business serving in Congress.

I called on Tony Gonzales to resign - now I'm calling on Eric Swalwell to resign.


San Francisco Chronicle (@sfchronicle)

A woman who worked for nearly two years for Rep. Eric Swalwell, a leading candidate for California governor, said she had sexual encounters with him while he was her boss and alleged he twice sexually assaulted her when she was

April is Sexual Assault Awareness Month.

Sexual assault remains one of the most underreported crimes in the country. Many survivors stay silent out of fear: fear of not being believed, fear of retaliation, and fear the system will fail them, as it has so many before.

But survivors are not defined by what was done to them. They are defined by their courage to keep going, to speak up, and to refuse to let what happened be the end of their story.

To every survivor reading this: you are not alone

Another member of Congress facing heinous and disgusting sexual misconduct allegations and this time, it's Eric Swalwell. 

Four women. A former staffer says he raped her while she was heavily intoxicated and left her bleeding and bruised. Unsolicited nude photos. Sexual assault. One pattern.

An alleged predator has no business serving in Congress. Eric Swalwell must RESIGN immediately.

We tried to expose this kind of behavior in Congress. Our resolution to release congressional sexual harassm

One thing has remained true through all of this: people need to go to prison.

But still, no one has.

We are not letting this go. We are not backing down. And we will use every tool at our disposal to deliver justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

Video
Law and order means the justice system works as hard to protect victims as it does to defend predators.

Those who serve and protect our nation deserve a healthcare system supporting them and their families. 

We reintroduced the Military Moms Act to improve maternal healthcare resources for service members and their spouses. 

By recognizing pregnancy and loss of pregnancy as a Qualifying Life Event under TRICARE, this bill gives military families the flexibility to choose the care plan best suited to their needs and ensures they can focus on their health and growing families without unnecessary r
Members of Congress committing sexual misconduct is egregious enough. Using your tax dollars to cover it up is even worse.

ICYMI: ZERO illegal immigrants have been released into our country for the 11th month straight.

Under the Trump administration, and through the hard work of all Department of Homeland Security agencies, we are seeing the most secure border in American history.

A country with secure borders is a strong country.

Last year, we ranked as the 22nd most bipartisan member of Congress out of 435 members.

Doing the right thing isn’t about party. It’s about morals, common sense, and the best interests of South Carolina.

We work with the other side when they get it right and call out our own side when they get it wrong.

Getting results has never been about politics. It’s about doing what’s right, no matter the cost.

Amnesty is never the answer to illegal immigration, deportations are.

NO to the DIGNIDAD Act.

We’re calling on the Department of Justice to do what’s right: release ALL of the Epstein files and prosecute those responsible to the fullest extent of the law.

No one should escape accountability for the trafficking and abuse of women and children, no matter how powerful.

Any day now.
Impeach corrupt judges.

The swamp and their allies in corporate media are renewing their push for the largest amnesty in American history – the DIGNIDAD Act – a bill so bad for the American people they couldn’t even name it in English.
 
As if naming their amnesty bill in a foreign language wasn’t insulting enough, the swamp is trying to convince you their amnesty bill, which would give legal status to 13+ million illegal aliens, isn’t actually amnesty. What else are you supposed to call allowing foreign nationals who

"We still must work openly and transparently to uncover the truth."

We will support EVERY effort to ensure Jeffrey Epstein’s victims get the justice they deserve. 

Thank you for your attention to this matter @FLOTUS.

When Melania Trump speaks with such grace and poise, the world listens.

Justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.
